info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Operational Service Internal Bank Account-spec
info.description: The Internal Bank Account Management API enables businesses to establish operational bank accounts seamlessly within their banking system. This API allows for the creation of new internal bank accounts essential for handling various financial operations. Financial institutions, accounting departments, and back-office systems will find this API crucial for ensuring efficient account management and compliance with internal policies. Additionally, it provides a foundational service for automating financial transactions and integrating with other banking services.

post.summary: Create a new internal bank account.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new internal bank account within the operational services. Ensure that you provide all necessary details in the request body to successfully create the account.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or update an internal bank account within the operational services. It should contain all necessary details about the bank account such as account number, account type, and associated bank information.
